tools.name: get_deck_spec
tools.description: Get artwork dimensions, supported formats, upload alternative and current deck price before preparing a design.

tools.name: create_deck
tools.description: Saves finished artwork on a skateboard deck and returns a browser link for 3D preview, editing and ordering, plus a picture of the deck assembled with trucks and wheels. Takes exactly one of image_base64 or composition. Stores an unlisted design; it generates no AI artwork and places no order. Each successful call creates a new design.

image_base64.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP file bytes as base64, optionally a data URL. Must be the bytes of an existing file; artwork made of shapes and text goes in composition.

composition.description: Alternative to an image: flat artwork in 1000 × 3833 units. Shapes use top-left x/y; text x/y is its baseline centre. Text can rotate -90 degrees along the deck.

fit.description: contain preserves the whole image; cover crops to fill the deck. The deck silhouette always clips the corners.

background.description: Six-digit hex colour that fills the deck around an image placed with contain.
